2292-3558-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
2292-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

751-3755-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
751-3755-4068.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4381-4694-7272-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-7272-7306.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least X life this turn.
728-6972-7237.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-7175.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

333-5686-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5686-7424.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

2981-4559-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2981-4559-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1399-1606-3664-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

773-1409-1418.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve both Galazeth Prismari triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

725-1329-1778-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Memnite, adding {1}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Memnite, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

3490-4289-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

147-5487.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Molten Duplication
147-5487.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Molten Duplication, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

821-2173-5220-6634.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2921-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4608-4661-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger.
4608-4661-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4608-4661-5466.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Doppelganger's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6798.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1170-1171-6791.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-6791.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

586-3497-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1017-4067-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
1017-4067-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a counter on O'aka.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

1690-1976-2538-2585.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
1690-1976-2538-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-1976-2538-2585.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1322-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1322-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

56-443-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-5256-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

116-390-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Hulking Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
116-390-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Hulking Metamorph.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Hulking Metamorph.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1308-2793-3743-5014-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3743-5014-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2715-4944.description:
Activate Chimeric Staff by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

575-1184-3585-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-1184-3585-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kin-Tree Warden.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

985-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

235-276-1811.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature and deal damage to it.
You have enough mana to pay for the instant or sorcery.
235-276-1811.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying the spell for each other creature you control the spell could target, ensuring that Imodane's copy is put onto the stack first.
Resolve the first copy, dealing twice the listed amount of damage to the targeted creature.
Imodane triggers, dealing four times the listed amount of damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining copy.

232-732-940-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Arcane Teachings attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-940-1636.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

3581-4053-5154.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor, adding {R}.
Lingering Tormentor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the batltefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

4050-4241-4871-5158.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4050-4241-4871-5158.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing the Treasure to become a 2/2 artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

1548-1550-1753.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Samut.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Samut and Port Razer.
1548-1550-1753.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Samut and Port Razer, triggering Sword of Hearth and Home and Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, exiling Port Razer, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Port Razer onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

431-851-1744.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2232-2459-3604.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2232-2459-3604.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or the command zone by paying {0} and commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Rograkh with haste.
The Rograkh token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rograkh token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

624-722-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Phantasmal Image each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

186-4131-5089.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-4131-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt's Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
